summary: The async job contract fal.ai, Black Forest Labs and RunPod each arrived at independently, as one hardened reference server: submit, poll, webhook. Idempotency keys that survive a restart, SSRF-guarded signed webhooks, and expiry as a status you can read rather than a silent 404. 156 tests.
